description: Register a scheduled agent loop. Stores the loop definition with its cron schedule, action type, and risk tier. The loop is created in 'active' status but does NOT auto-execute in v1 — use execute_loop to trigger manually. The schedule is stored for v2 daemon support.

action_type.description: Type of action this loop performs (e.g., 'send_email', 'generate_report', 'sync_data', 'health_check')

description.description: Detailed description of what this loop does each cycle. Be specific — governance evaluates this text.

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata (e.g., owner, team, target_system)

risk_tier.description: Risk tier — determines governance gate strictness. 'critical' loops will almost always require human review.

schedule.description: Cron expression for the schedule (e.g., '0 9 * * *' for daily at 9am, '@hourly'). Stored but not auto-executed in v1.

name: register_loop
